page.title: Shareholders
page.description: The Shareholders site supports the team handling day-to-day shareholder administration for Moonlight Resources. Shareholder Communications holds notices, letters and other correspondence sent to shareholders, and Forms covers the registry-related paperwork shareholders are asked to complete (e.g. change of address, dividend instructions). For public market disclosures, see the Investor Relations site instead — this one is about servicing existing shareholders directly.
